production_responsibility.handoff: The provider publishes a digest-addressed package and contract/golden bundle; ClawX consumes that package without reading a mutable checkout.

state.m1: No provider state is created; missing state is unavailable, not initialized.
state.m2: ClawX host explicitly creates provider state in a declared per-user provider-state root after approval.

shared_sidecar.reference_rebuild: recover from owner and lease records before accepting new work
shared_sidecar.last_consumer_shutdown: drain then stop; never delete evidence

state.upgrade_interruption: preserve old state, report recovery_required, never start a half-upgraded authority

delivery.consumer_rule: ClawX consumes a digest-addressed package, not a mutable checkout path.
delivery.dirty_source_policy: dirty or untracked provider source cannot produce an accepted package

rules: VG must not delete a host worktree
Host must not delete while VG references remain
All cleanup entries must pass the same barrier before deletion
Evidence retention has priority over directory cleanup
Any failed barrier step preserves the resource
